name: @envsave/cli
description: Local secret vault for LLM-safe environments — encrypted secrets that agents can't bulk-discover

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --outfile dist/index.js && cp .claude/skills/envsave/SKILL.md dist/SKILL.md
scripts.lint:claude: claude -p 'you are a linter. please look at the changes vs. main and report any issues related to typos. report the filename and line number on one line, and a description of the issue on the second line. do not return any other text.'

author: Jose C Sancho
